description.value: Ironworks Café & Crêperie is a Vancouver Island cafe chain open since 2018, built around made-from-scratch Belgian-style crepes and locally roasted Italian coffee. The brand operates confirmed locations in Duncan and Nanaimo and references a Ladysmith presence in customer reviews and footer listings, though that location's current status is uncertain. The menu spans sweet and savoury crepes with broad dietary accommodation, including vegan and gluten-free batter choices.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ironworks Café & Crêperie is a real, active business with locations in Duncan and Nanaimo, but the Ladysmith location at 422 Esplanade Avenue has no dedicated page and appears only in a customer review and in footer boilerplate listing 'Nanaimo, Duncan, Ladysmith, and Chemanius (seasonal)' — insufficient to confirm it is currently open. The OSM phone (+1 250-912-0064) does not match the website's published number (1.855.748.9371), and the website clearly confirms vegan, whole-wheat, and gluten-free batter options across the menu.
concerns: Ladysmith location has no dedicated page on the website; only mentioned in a customer review and generic footer text listing 'Nanaimo, Duncan, Ladysmith, and Chemanius (seasonal)' — current operating status unknown.
Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1 250-912-0064 but the website publishes 1.855.748.9371 (toll-free corporate line).
Name spelling differs: OSM uses 'Iron Works Cafe & Creperie' while the website uses 'Ironworks Café & Crêperie'.
Address unverifiable: the website does not list 422 Esplanade Avenue for any current location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Ladysmith location at 422 Esplanade Avenue is not listed as a current active location on the brand website — only Duncan and Nanaimo have dedicated location pages — making it impossible to confirm whether this specific location is open or has closed.
